result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where the bottom navigation bar lacks safe-area padding, causing the navigation icons to be clipped at the bottom edge and overlapped by the system home indicator.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar icons (Home, Search, Orders, Profile) are positioned too low, causing them to be clipped by the bottom edge of the screen and overlapped by the system home indicator bar.
issues.suggestion: Add appropriate bottom safe-area inset padding to the bottom navigation bar so that all navigation icons sit cleanly above the system home indicator without clipping or overlap.
